info.title: GitLab REST API
info.description:
GitLab REST API v4 provides programmatic access to GitLab repositories, branches, commits, merge requests, groups, members, pipelines, CI/CD variables, releases, environments, and deployments.

Authentication: API key — use a Personal Access Token, group access token, or project access token. Generate at GitLab → User Settings → Access Tokens. Pass as a PRIVATE-TOKEN: <token> header.

Source: https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/rest/
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 133 of 1008 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: projects, groups, members, branches, protected branches, repository files, commits, tags, protected tags, merge requests, pipelines, pipeline schedules, jobs, CI/CD variables, releases, environments, deployments, deploy keys, deploy tokens, and project-level runners. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
